content: आश्रयः [आश्रि-अच्] .²1 A resting-place, seat, substratum; सौहृदादपृथगाश्रयामिमाम् <ls>U. 1. 45</ls>. so आश्रयासिद्ध <ab>q. v.</ab> below. .²2 That on which anything depends or rests or with which it is closely connected. .²3 Recipient, receptacle, a person or thing in which any quality is present or retained <ab>&c.</ab>; तमाश्रयं दुष्प्रसहस्य तेजसः <ls>R. 3. 58</ls>. .²4 .³({%a%}) A place of refuge, asylum; shelter; भर्ता वै ह्याश्रयः स्त्रीणाम् <ls>Vet.</ls>; तदहमाश्रयोन्मूलनेनैव त्वामकामां करोमि <ls>Mu. 2</ls>. .³({%b%}) A dwelling, house. .²5 Having recourse or resort to, resort; <ab>oft.</ab> in <ab>comp.</ab> साभूद्रामाश्रया भूयः <ls>R. 12. 35</ls>; नानाश्रया प्रकृतिः <ab>&c.</ab> .²6 Following, practising; योऽवमन्येत ते मूले हेतुशास्त्राश्रयाद् द्विजः <ls>Ms. 2. 11</ls>. .²7 Choosing, taking, attaching oneself to. .²8 Dependence on; <ab>oft.</ab> in <ab>comp.</ab>; मम सर्वे विषयास्त्वदाश्रयाः <ls>R. 8. 69</ls>. .²9 Patron, supporter; विनाश्रयं न तिष्ठन्ति पण्डिता वनिता लताः <ls>Udb.</ls> .²10 A prop, support; वृक्षेषु विद्धमिषुभिर्जघनाश्रयेषु <ls>R. 9. 60</ls>. .²11 Help, assistance, protection. .²12 A quiver; बाणमाश्रयमुखात् समुद्धरन् <ls>R. 11. 26</ls>. .²13 Authority, sanction, warrant. .²14 Connection, relation, association. राघवाश्रयसत्कथाः <ls>Rām. 6. 90. 93</ls>. .²15 Union, attachment. .²16 A plea, an excuse. .²17 Contiguity, vicinity. .²18 Seeking shelter or protection with another (= संश्रय), one of the six {%guṇas%}, <ab>q. v.</ab> .²19 An appropriate act, or one consistent with character. .²20 Source, origin. .²21 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) The subject, or that to which the predicate is attached. .²22 (With Buddhists) The five organs of sense with {%Manas%} or mind.
